Aurora Winter Blues Festival Pass: Choose all 4 evening and 2 matinee performances (6 Shows) for $199 – discount at checkout Aurora Cultural Centre Presents Jack de Keyzer Aurora Winter Blues Festival Aurora Town Square Performance Hall 50 Victoria Street, Aurora 6:45 pm Doors Open 7:30 pm Show Start Don’t miss Jack de Keyzer, one of Canada’s greatest blues guitarists, as he lights up the stage with his powerhouse band. A 2-time Juno and 7-time Maple Blues Award winner, de Keyzer delivers electrifying performances that span his award-winning catalogue and timeless blues, rock, and soul classics. With a sound rooted in Chicago blues, British blues rock, and Southern soul, his playing is both masterful and deeply authentic—shaped by years performing alongside legends like Bo Diddley, Otis Rush, and Etta James. About the Aurora Winter Blues Festival Get ready to warm up your winter! The Aurora Winter Blues Festival is back with four nights of toe-tapping, soul-shaking, heart-thumping music. Presented by the Aurora Cultural Centre, AWBF is your mid-winter escape into the world of blues, roots, and everything in between. It’s cozy, it’s cool, and it’s the perfect way to turn up the heat this February. This presentation is made possible with the support of Season Sponsor Funders The Aurora Cultural Centre participates in the Access 2 Program and supports removing the barriers to arts access for patrons with disabilities and their support persons.
